programme.desc: While Ted and Puma address the fallout from Orlando, Tatti starts her new life post Black Ink. Bae attempts to make amends with Krystal as Rok decides whether he's more loyal to Krystal or Black Ink.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.desc: Divorcee Mathew McGough is taking his five-year-old daughter Shannon for an overnight camping trip.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive

programme.desc: Kevin and Heather Miller's marital strife leads to an affair, Wiccan rituals and belladonna.

programme.title: Sex, Lies & Murder

programme.desc: Newlyweds Brandon and Brandy Wiley are on a backpacking adventure in Costa Rica.

programme.sub-title: A Strange Deadly Robbery: The Isabelle Mosser Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: In Search of SK1 - Akira Ojima Case

programme.sub-title: In Search of SK1 - Akira Ojima Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
programme.desc: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.
programme.sub-title: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)
programme.desc: On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed.
programme.sub-title: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Sylvie Darcy Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Four Lovers For One Crime: The Joël Deprez Affair
programme.desc: On February 5, 2000, two hunters discover a charred body on the banks of the Oise.
programme.sub-title: Four Lovers For One Crime: The Joël Deprez Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Strange Hanging - Chantal Ternik Case

programme.sub-title: A Strange Hanging - Chantal Ternik Case

programme.title: South Park: Pandemic (Part 1)
programme.desc: Pandemic (1): South Park goes all 'Cloverfield' when large, mysterious creatures begin causing havoc around the globe, all caught on Randy's shaky cam. The boys start a Peruvian flute band. (S12, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Pandemic 2: The Startling (Part 2)
programme.desc: Pandemic 2 - The Startling (2): Giant guinea pigs are attacking cities around the world. The boys have the key which will save humanity, but they are stuck in the Andes and bored to boot! (S12, E11)

programme.title: South Park: About Last Night...
programme.desc: About Last Night...: While the country celebrates the election of Obama, a band of unlikely super-thieves begin an audacious jewel heist. The town's Republicans fear the apocalypse is nigh. (S12, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Elementary School Musical
programme.desc: Elementary School Musical: When the all-singing and dancing musical craze hits South Park, the boys must embrace it or relinquish their popularity. Will they stick to their guns? (S12, E13)

programme.title: South Park: The Ungroundable
programme.desc: The Ungroundable: Fed up with how he is treated by his parents, the eternally innocent Butters embraces the new vampire craze a little too enthusiastically. Who will he choose to feed on? (S12, E14)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: The Ring: To the amazement of the boys Kenny has a girlfriend, but they must face the might of Disney and its leader to free Kenny from the powers of his libido-squashing purity ring. (S13, E01)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: The 'C**n: By day he is Eric Cartman, a fat fourth-grader. By night, he is The C**n, a crime fighting vigilante dressed in a raccoon outfit, desperate for attention. But who is Mysterion? (S13, E02)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Margaritaville: In a riff on the story of Christ, Randy implores the town to stop angering the economy with rash purchases, but a young Jew, Kyle, challenges this orthodox teaching. (S13, E03)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eat, Pray, Queef: When a new Canadian show called The Queef Sisters starts a 'queefing' craze the men of South Park are disgusted by this new female craze and move to get it banned. (S13, E04)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Fishsticks: Jimmy is angry that Cartman tries to take credit for a joke he created that is now sweeping the nation. But an angry Kanye West just can't get his head around the punch line. (S13, E05)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pinewood Derby: Randy and Stan somehow discover warp speed, allowing Earth to join the Galactic Federation of Planets, but will an alien gangster and his 'space cash' ruin everything? (S13, E06)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Fatbeard: Cartman hears of all the riches being plundered by the pirates in Somalia, so dons his eye patch and leads a motley crew off to Africa to get in on the act. (S13, E07)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Dead Celebrities: The ghost of Michael Jackson refuses to accept his death, leaving the rest of the recently dead celebrities frustrated in purgatory and poor Ike having ghostly visits! (S13, E08)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Butter's Bottom B***h: Oblivious to his actions, the little innocent Butters starts up 'The Kissing Company', and is soon the most notorious pimp around. Will undercover cops ruin his fun? (S13, E09)
programme.sub-title: Hotter than Summer: Butters' Bottom Bitch

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: W. T. F.: After seeing their first live WWE wrestling match the boys decide to form their own wrestling federation... and gain a huge redneck following! (S13, E10)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Whale W****s: Kyle joins the crew of a reality documentary show who confront Japanese whalers, but finds their tactics leave a lot to be desired for and that war with Japan beckons! (S13, E11)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: The F Word: The boys confront a group of obnoxious bikers, but their methods force the townsfolk to redefine the meaning of a rather offensive word. Time to update the English Dictionary! (S13, E12)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Dances With Smurfs: Cartman's vitriol finally gets a platform when he is chosen to be the school's morning announcer, and he unashamedly abuses his position. Power corrupts... (S13, E13)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pee: High levels of pee in the pool cause a disaster which ruins the day for the boys, Kyle especially. Eric's xenophobia pops up again when he believes himself "the last of his species". (S13, E14)

programme.title: Sea Patrol: Episode 006
programme.desc: The crew of the HMAS Hammersley are assigned the task of protecting a shipment of nuclear waste from a terrorist attack.

programme.title: Sea Patrol: Episode 007
programme.desc: A daring rescue at an abandoned nuclear test site causes the crew of the HMAS Hammersley to be exposed to toxic radiation.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: Greg is forced to again contend with the hostile mother and brother of the hoodlum he killed in self-defense several months ago when the CSI team discovers that the brother is involved in a new murder case.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: While Grissom and the rest of the CSIs are out investigating new cases, Hodges leads Archie, Henry, Mandy and Wendy to believe that Grissom wants them to secretly band together that evening in an attempt to solve the four miniature killer cases.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: In their attempt to identify the murderer of a has-been boxer who lived among a group of prostitutes who detested him, the CSIs must establish which of several life-threatening acts against him in one night actually killed him.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Fragments
programme.desc: Andy’s former rookie, Duncan, is back on duty and looking to reconcile – something she’s not ready for yet. But personal feelings get thrust aside when a bomb explodes in a downtown parking garage

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Everlasting
programme.desc: The officers of 15 Division work to track down TED MCDONALD (the car-bomber from Ep. 510). But even after catching him, they realize Ted has more targets set to explode out there. The clock is ticking

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Open Windows
programme.desc: Andy is attacked by an intruder at Traci’s place and the Sex Crimes Unit steps in to take over the case their way, 15 Division will have decide whether to take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: The CIA promises Kane that killing a notorious organ trafficker will bring Kane one step closer to The Ghost.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: Bojan, a ghost from Kane’s past resurfaces and the CIA believes Bojan is in town to protect The Ghost’s personal money launderer - who is also coming to town.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: Kane wants to know what the Ghost is buying and knows the answer will get him one step closer to The Ghost…

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: Kane and his team track two suitcase nukes that have been smuggled into the country – and Kane thinks the Ghost is working to buy them.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: When his daughter takes part in an anti-nuclear rally, Kessler is suspected of leaking classified information that leads directly to nuclear sabotage.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: ICS must find a sadistic kidnapper before he auctions off his 12-year-old victim on a pedophile website.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: Kessler discovers a Croatian war criminal has been granted amnesty, and must struggle with demons from his own past in Bosnia.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: Three American soldiers plunge into the Niagara River and swim to Canada. Deserters, refusing to return to Iraq under the U.S.’s “stop loss” policy, they seek refugee status in Canada.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: An international assassin, Monita Persaud, turns up in downtown Toronto. Her target: a political cartoonist who has enraged the Muslim world. The ICS squad tracks down Persaud, only to discover a more ominous conspiracy.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: The CSI team investigates the murder of a blackjack dealer whose estranged husband has ties to a club of UFO believers.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: A Cartman no le queda otra que admitir que esta gordo, pero en lugar de hacer dieta para bajar de peso comienza a movilizarse en un scooter.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los hombres de South Park comienzan a creer que un cartero de la UPS se acuesta con sus esposas. Esto desata la locura en la ciudad, y todos quieren tener el mejor sistema de seguridad en sus casas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El buen Butters se encuentra muy agresivo últimamente, y al parecer es debido a su herencia Hawaiana. Butters junto a Kenny se van a Hawái para celebrar la ceremonia conocida como Hapa Noa.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En Halloween, los cuatro amigos se disfrazan de Los Vengadores. Mientras tanto, Randy, el papa de Stan, hace un mal negocio con la tienda de videos Blockbuster.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El pueblo se entera de que los milagros de Jesús se realizaron cuando estaba drogado y todos estan decepcionados de el por lo que quieren liberarse de sus Scausas (Pulseras).

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Obama vuelve a ganar las elecciones, pero al parecer, fue con la ayuda de Cartman en complicidad con el gobierno chino.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se infiltra en la Agencia de Seguridad Nacional porque cree que lo están espiando, y no le gusta lo que encuentra en su expediente personal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los adultos de la ciudad están obsesionados con los programas de homicidios de la tv, por lo cual los niños deciden bloquear esos canales.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman teme que Token y otros afroamericanos comiencen un apocalipsis zombi al estilo Guerra Mundial Z, la película de Brad Pitt. Así que corre por todo South Park para poner fin a esta amenaza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Henrietta, la chica gótica, es enviada a un campamento para niños con problemas emocionales. Cuando regresa, sus amigos descubren que se convirtió en una chica Emo.
programme.sub-title: Chicos Góticos 3: El Origen de los Pretenciosos

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ike llega la pubertad y comienza a distanciarse de Kyle. Para salvar la relación con su hermano, Kyle decide llevar a Ike a ver una presentación en vivo de su programa de televisión favorito.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha logrado “la paz mundial” gracias a una de sus bromas para humillar a Kyle. Este acontecimiento reúne a miles de líderes religiosos de todo el mundo en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se preparan para luchar contra las multitudes que hacen la cola en el primer día oficial de las compras navideñas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La traición de la “Princesa Kenny” dejó a Cartman loco por venganza y los niños se preparan para una batalla épica en donde sólo una plataforma de videojuegos será la ganadora.
programme.sub-title: Una canción De culo y fuego

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos deciden crear una empresa financiada con micro donaciones masivas a través de internet para alejarse de sus estudios y comenzar una nueva vida en la cual no deban hacer nada.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos vuelven a la escuela, pero ahora todos los demás estudiantes los odian. Mientras, el consejero Mackey deja su adicción al gluten y comienza a decir lo bien que se siente.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se hace pasar por transexual para poder usar el baño de las niñas en la escuela. Mientras tanto, Randy lleva una doble vida, consiguiendo fama como la famosa cantante adolescente Lorde.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman y Butters miran con asombro un dron y no logran resistir la tentación de maniobrarlo por la ciudad, invadiendo la privacidad de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan se vuelve adicto al nuevo juego móvil de Terrance y Phillip intenta convencer a sus amigos de que es el mejor juego de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le juega una broma a Butters haciéndole creer que está usando un casco de realidad virtual. Butters comienza a causar estragos, ya que no logra distinguir la diferencia entre real y virtual.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kenny es un excelente jugador de “Magic: The Gathering” por lo que comienza a ser el centro de atención. Mientras tanto, Wendy decide pasar más tiempo con Stan y ver qué es lo que hace.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle quiere jugar a los videojuegos con su hermano menor. Pero cuando Ike no quiere jugar más con él, Kyle teme que la próxima generación lo haya superado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El show de Cartman es tendencia, mientras que el país se prepara para vivir la fiesta mas espectacular jamás vista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey hace una convocatoria a los padres y estudiantes de la primaria de South Park para anunciar que la directora Victoria ha sido despedida, siendo reemplazada por el director PC.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Las niñas asiáticas de la escuela están dibujando imágenes románticas al estilo manga de Tweek y Craig, creando una gran confusión entre los alumnos y los padres.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras Kenny y los chicos juegan a ser ninjas, todos en South Park empiezan a creer que en realidad forman parte de una organización terrorista.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: ¿Los antiguos oráculos griegos eran realmente adivinos o solo predecían bajo la influencia de fenómenos tectónicos?

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: Contemple las pirámides, el Valle de los Reyes y más mientras recorremos los sitios sagrados de Egipto y revelamos sus secretos ocultos.

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: Descubra si fueron fuerzas externas las que condenaron a la gente del Cañón del Chaco o si ellos mismos fueron los autores de su propia desgracia.

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: Desde Camelot hasta la búsqueda del Santo Grial, aprende qué hay de cierto en el mito del Rey Arturo.

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: Recorreremos México y Guatemala hasta los sitios sagrados mayas y descubriremos nuevos secretos sobre los motivos de su construcción.

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: Descubra asombrosos hallazgos sobre el Camino de Santiago mientras los científicos examinan los orígenes de los antiguos trayectos espirituales.

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: Siga de cerca al equipo de expertos en su búsqueda por los lugares sagrados de Malta para explicar la desaparición de los Pueblos del Templo.

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: Descubra los sorprendentes secretos sobre el poder político y sexual que poseían las mujeres del antiguo Egipto.

programme.title: Sacred Sites LT
programme.desc: Acompañe a científicos de todo el mundo mientras estudian lugares sagrados que los nazis una vez afirmaron que fueron construidos por y para una antigua raza aria.

programme.title: Sacred Sites: Ireland
programme.desc: Hasta los días de hoy, estudiosos intentan entender cuáles fueron los motivos de los cambios de creencias y hábitos de los antiguos pueblos irlandeses, se cree que los motivos pueden ser místicos.

programme.title: Saving Treasures
programme.desc: Don Williams, conservador del Museo Smithsoniano, nos sumergirá en el mundo de las fotografías.

programme.title: Seriously Amazing Objects LT
programme.desc: Un fanático de los cómics, un entusiasta de la aviación y un aficionado de las palomas están a punto de tener la mejor visita de sus vidas.

programme.title: Seriously Amazing Objects LT
programme.desc: Únase a los visitantes del Smithsoniano en una aventura cercana con Toro Sentado, Rosie la remachadora y Thomas Edison.

programme.title: Seriously Amazing Objects LT
programme.desc: Vea una famosa computadora portátil, una pepita de la época de la fiebre del oro, a Óscar el Gruñón y la chalina roja de Susan B. Anthony.

programme.title: Seriously Amazing Objects LT
programme.desc: Descubra cómo un día normal en el Smithsoniano puede convertirse en un almuerzo con Abraham Lincoln y un viaje a bordo del Ford Modelo T de 1913.

programme.title: Seriously Amazing Objects LT
programme.desc: Nuestro mundo existe gracias a las herramientas, desde las hachas de piedra utilizadas hace casi dos millones de años a los teléfonos inteligentes de los que dependemos hoy en día.

programme.title: Seriously Amazing Objects LT
programme.desc: Siga a los visitantes del Smithsoniano mientras alimentan a las chitas, aprenden sobre té samurái y conocen la historia de la cometa que ayudó a ganar una guerra.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Usando sus métodos poco ortodoxos, los Colton combinan sus talentos individuales para crear un equipo de cazarrecompensas de clase mundial en este episodio derivado de MacGyver.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver y Pete Thornton recuerdan aventuras pasadas mientras Pete se prepara para una cirugía ocular para tratar su glaucoma.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver y la Fundación Phoenix supervisan la seguridad y protección de Delasora durante su juicio. MacGyver está obsesionado con la muerte de Murdoc y cree que todavía está vivo.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: La vecina de MacGyver, Kelly Dobbs, escucha un plan para asesinar al contador Victor Nesbitt. Victor es contador en una de las sociedades de cartera de Lyle Knox y planea exponer a la empresa.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver recoge al padre de su mejor amigo para llevarlo al bar mitzvá de su nieto y, sin darse cuenta, se ve involucrado en una misión del FBI y la CIA.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Después de que Prometheus, un pirómano enloquecido, es responsable de la muerte de su viejo amigo, MacGyver se propone resolver el misterio de este loco y capturarlo.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver se enfrenta al extraño y aterrador mundo del vudú, mientras intenta salvar a su vecino políticamente activo de un escuadrón de la muerte trastornado y clandestino.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Un golpe en la cabeza lleva a MacGyver a la Inglaterra del siglo VII, donde busca sus raíces y rescata a una hermosa doncella de una reina malvada.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Un golpe en la cabeza lleva a MacGyver a la Inglaterra del siglo VII, donde busca sus raíces y rescata a una hermosa doncella de una reina malvada.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Un comediante de cine mudo retirado, Pinky, dona sus películas a la Fundación Phoenix y juntos, él y MacGyver, se encuentran atrapados en una trampa mortal tejida por un maestro de efectos especiales llamado Neil que busca venganza.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver ayuda a su buen amigo Dent a entrenar para un combate de boxeo y descubre que debe rescatar a la hija de Dent de los jugadores que la han secuestrado.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Mientras trabaja en el Challenger Club,MacGyver descubre que debe salvar a los pandilleros locales de Minton, el proveedor local de armas que planea matar a todos los pandilleros y dejar que Jefferies cargue con la culpa de un asesinato que no cometió.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver lucha para salvar un proyecto de vivienda después de que los propietarios corruptos hambrientos de dinero obligaron a los inquilinos a abandonar sus hogares.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver y su viejo amigo Jack Dalton descubren que los habitantes de un valle montañoso viven más de 150 años. Desafortunadamente, también descubren que es el sitio secreto de una planta de agua pesada utilizada para la tecnología de armas nucleares.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Cuando MacGyver se involucra en un plan para detener el trabajo esclavo chino, descubre que tiene un hijo, Sam, que también está interesado en provocar la caída del hombre detrás de todo.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver es un héroe estadounidense moderno con la extraña habilidad de resolver una crisis en un tiempo extremadamente limitado, ya sea el audaz rescate de un arma secreta en la cima de una montaña o la salvación de científicos atrapados bajo tierra.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver escapa de un proyectil de bazuca cuidadosamente apuntado, se arrastra a través del lodo y crea el caos dentro de una fuerza militar corrupta para salvar a una hermosa reportera gráfica de un sindicato criminal mortal de América del Sur.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver, sin darse cuenta, invade un campamento en la jungla birmana y usa materiales primitivos para crear una serie de trampas para ayudar a los aldeanos que han sido víctimas de un ejército privado de mercenarios.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos ganan muchos dulces en un concurso, pero para reclamar el premio necesitan el cupón ganador el cual le dieron a Kenny antes de morir.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le cuenta a sus amigos sobre un extraño sueño que tuvo en donde unos ''visitantes'' lo abducen y le ponen una sonda anal. Pero al parecer, no fue sólo un sueño, ya que algo está desollando a las vacas del pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: ¡Parece que el Coon es más nefasto incluso que el Señor Oscuro, Cthulhu! Mientras que el Coon castiga a sus antiguos amigos, Kenny lucha con la maldición de su súper poderes a través de su alter ego, Mysterion.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman decide entrar en el negocio de la venta de fetos abortados. Por otro lado, Kenny contrae una enfermedad muscular mortal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La verdadera identidad de Mysterions es revelada. Mientras tanto, el Coon, despreciado por sus compañeros súper héroes, está en busca de venganza, y logra convencer a Cthulu para ser compañeros de equipo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos encuentran un antiguo objeto triangular en una excavación escolar. Luego de salir en el noticiero, Barbra Streisand aparece buscándolo ya que es lo que necesita para poder convertirse en un monstruo gigante japonés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En el homenaje de South Park a la película "Heavy Metal", los chicos tratan de que Kenny se libre de la última locura por las drogas que ha capturado a la escuela.

programme.desc: La ciudad de South Park está en crisis y Kenny piensa que es hora de conseguir un trabajo.
programme.sub-title: La ciudad que es parte del pueblo

programme.desc: El abuelo de Stan cumple 102 años y quiere suicidarse, pero al no poder hacerlo, le pide a Stan que lo ayude.

programme.desc: Varios habitantes de South Park explotan sin razón aparente y Randy es el encargado de descubrir por qué. Por otro lado, los chicos tienen que representar las "Estaciones de la cruz" en misa, y Kyle trata de ''conseguir una erección''.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuento Southparkitero del libro "Grandes Esperanzas" de Dickens, teniendo como protagonista a Pip, un inglés de clase pobre, y con Malcolm McDowell, un británico como narrador.

programme.desc: Cartman se enoja porque Kenny consiguió una consola de videojuegos y él no. Pero Kenny muere al llegar al nivel 60, y va al cielo y se entera que Dios lo mató a propósito ya que lo necesitan para que salve al cielo de un ataque de Satanás.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En Halloween, los chicos quieren asustar a los de quinto grado, así que desentierran el cadáver de la abuela de Kyle. Mientras tanto, la banda Korn está en South Park y unos fantasmas piratas asechan a los habitantes.

programme.title: Red Norvo, Dave Brubeck Quartet, The Gary Burton Quartet & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: G.B. 4, Red N., D.G. Band, D.B. 4 - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, jazz's greatest artists appeared at the third Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam. This broadcast features the bands of pianist Dave Brubeck, vibraphonists Gary Burton and Red Norvo, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962. Appearing with a group that includes the French pianist George Arvanitas, one-time Duke Ellington bassist Jimmy Woode, and expat drummer Kansas Fields, the musician also known as ‘Bean' and ‘Hawk' serves up an hour-long set of familiar standards bookended by Hank Jones' “Chant” and J. J. Johnson's “Wee Dot”.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Charlie Parker
programme.desc: The documentary The Story of Jazz is a seamless array of performances, commentary, and compelling historic insights about jazz, zooming in on the cross-cultural influences that produced this constantly evolving and enduring music. Many call jazz the greatest art form of the 20th century. This absorbing weave of sounds, rare film clips, stills and interviews shows how this truly American expression spread to become a universal, musical language, from the New Orleans traditions, stride, swing, boogie woogie, big band, jump band, blues, bebop, Afro-Cuban, cool, and free-form, to jazz vocalists and dancers… Never before have the filmed comments of so many important great jazz artists been assembled for one project, and never before has the history of jazz been told as vividly and with such attention to historic detail.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Astrud Gilberto
programme.sub-title: Astrud Gilberto Band Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. “The Girl From Ipanema”, Astrud Gilberto's second name. The Brazilian bossa-nova and samba singer gives an outstanding, swinging performance at Estival Lugano. The band features Marcello Gilberto, David Sacks, Gil Goldstein, and Eduardo da Fonseca. Astrud started to record her own compositions in the '70s. She has recorded songs in Portuguese, English, Spanish, Italian, French, German, and Japanese.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Michael Blicher
programme.sub-title: Blicher Hemmer Gadd - A Music documentary
programme.desc: Award-winning saxophonist Michael Blicher, Hammond wizard Dan Hemmer and legendary drummer Steve Gadd joined forces in 2014 to celebrate their shared love for Hammond-organ soul jazz. The band, which tours extensively throughout the world, has released several albums. Their third album, which was released in November 2019, features U.K. vocalist Paul Carrack on the soulful ballad 'The First One To Know'.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads his Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg's Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31, recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland, USA. In addition, Welser-Möst takes a walk through ‘his' Vienna, enlightening us on this musical capital that was home to both Mozart and Schoenberg. He contrasts the Divertimento No. 2, written by 16-year-old Mozart, with Variations for Orchestra, by the mature Schoenberg.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed his Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work around the same time as his Symphony No. 6, ‘Pastorale'. Both symphonies saw their premieres in a legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 5 has become one of the best-known compositions in western classical music. It opens with the famous four-note motif, often interpreted as the musical manifestation of 'fate knocking at the door'. This rhythmic figure returns in various guises in the other three movements of the symphony. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Brahms - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 73
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances present Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 73. Whereas it took the composer over a decade to complete his first symphony, he penned his Symphony No. 2 in just a few months, during his summer sojourn in the restful Austrian village of Pörtschach in 1877. Nicknamed his ‘Pastoral' symphony, the work is arguably the most sunny and optimistic of Brahms's four symphonies. Lyrical in character, it features joyful melodies. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Simone Lamsma, Gianandrea Noseda & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Dutch violinist Simone Lamsma brings lyricism and fire to Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's virtuosic Violin Concerto, joining conductor Gianandrea Noseda and the London Symphony Orchestra. Tchaikovsky wrote the piece in 1878 on the shores of Lake Geneva, collaborating closely with his former student and lover, violinist Iosif Kotek. The composer initially intended to dedicate the piece to the young Kotek, but eventually dedicated it to another violinist, Leopold Auer, as he was afraid of the gossip the dedication would cause. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on April 10, 2022.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer & Budapest Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach's Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók's best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. Remarkable is the work's instrumentation: Bartók divided the strings into two groups that are placed on opposite sides of the stage, to create antiphonal effects. The program ends with Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.

programme.title: Alanis Morissette
programme.desc: Alanis Morissette is one of the most successful female artists and songwriters of all time and has sold in excess of 60 million albums worldwide. programme.title: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: (2010) Tense thriller starring Kristanna Loken. A young woman is drawn into a web of deception when she arrives in New York to settle the affairs of her murdered best friend.

programme.title: Mommy's Cheating Scandal
programme.desc: (2021) Thriller based on real-life events, with Karis Cameron. A student gets caught in an admission scandal in a bid to get into a good college. A manhunt for the ring leader has deadly consequences.

programme.title: Secrets That Kill
programme.desc: Jenny is unhappy when her mum Laura returns from a world cruise with a new younger husband.

programme.title: Hidden Truth
programme.desc: (2016) Intense thriller with Sarah Lind. After her brother is accused of murder, Jamie tries to clear his name, uncovering dark secrets and a killer who will do anything to get away with it...

programme.title: American Heist
programme.desc: (2014) Action thriller with Hayden Christensen and Adrien Brody. After serving time for a crime they both committed, one brother threatens to drag the other back into criminality.

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: In this wickedly funny and moving story, Sir reflects on his accomplishments and seeks to reconcile his turbulent friendships with those in his employ before the final curtain.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: In the wake of a painful estrangement from his daughter, boxing trainer Frankie Dunn has been unwilling to let himself get close to anyone for a very long time – then Maggie Fitzgerald walks into his gym.

programme.title: Away From Her
programme.desc: A double-Oscar-nominated, beautifully subtle exploration of Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: One Night In Miami…
programme.desc: This powerful film is a fictional account of one incredible night where American icons Muhammad Ali (Eli Goree), Malcolm X (Kingsley Ben-Adir), Sam Cooke (Leslie Odom Jr.), and Jim Brown (Aldis Hodge) gathered, discussing their roles in the civil rights movement and cultural upheaval of the 1960s.

programme.title: A Mother's Instinct
programme.desc: When a boy goes missing, clues lead his sister and mother to believe their asocial neighbor was involved in the abduction forcing them to take the law into their own hands.

programme.title: Here Kills the Bride
programme.desc: Carlos' sister finds out that he is getting married in a week to Grace, a girl he just met in a strip club. His sister investigates and gets pulled into a whirlwind of events, putting her own life at risk.

programme.title: Children of Dune: Chapter 2
programme.desc: The Atreides Family must overcome a conspiracy that threatens to destroy their legacy and undermine their House in the eyes of The Empire. Only Paul's children can stop this catastrophe from destroying everything and saving House Atreides from this malevolent force.

programme.title: Rupture
programme.desc: Young mother Renee (Noomi Rapace, The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo) is randomly abducted and taken to a secret lab, where she is traumatically experimented on. She must uncover why she is chosen and escape her prison.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: At a turning point in his life, a former tennis pro falls for an actress who happens to be dating his friend and soon-to-be brother-in-law.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace becomes a princess when a summer trip to Paris turns into the fantasy of a lifetime.

programme.title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
programme.desc: The south of France. Two rival con men -- one is suave and sophisticated, the other is a third-rate American hustler -- make a wager.

programme.title: Be Cool
programme.desc: John Travolta is back as Chili Palmer in this sequel to "Be Cool." With an all-star cast that includes Uma Thurman and The Rock, "Be Cool" is the hilarious tale about a gangster-turned-music-mogul...and what it takes to be number one with a bullet!

programme.title: I'm Not There
programme.desc: The life of Bob Dylan is examined through multiple variations of his own personality and career.

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: A biopic depicting the early years of aviator Howard Hughes' career from the late 1920s to the mid 1940s.

programme.title: Green Book
programme.desc: A white bouncer drives a black classical pianist during a tour across the American South in the 1960s.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
programme.desc: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: For one family protecting their land on the Texas-Mexico border is everything but an encounter with an immigrant family leads to Jackson accidentally killing a boy. With his father Bill (Frank Grillo - Captain America: The Winter Soldier) attempting to take the blame, Jackson flees and crosses the border into Mexico. Now an illegal alien himself, he faces the very fears he imposed on others.

programme.title: At First Light
programme.desc: The producer of Midnight Special and Sinister 2 bring you this supernatural, coming-of-age thriller. High school senior, Alex (Stefanie Scott: Beautiful Boy, Insidious Chapter 3), has a paranormal experience in her hometown, which leaves her with dangerous, supernatural abilities but no recollection of who she is or how she got her powers until she comes across her friend Sean, who offers to take her in. However, when a mysterious organization with questionable motives tracks her down, the two are forced to run away, embarking on an adventure to unearth the truth of what actually transpired that one night.

programme.title: Shadow Walkers
programme.desc: Project X meets sci-fi chiller in this trippy, supernatural thriller. Three college friends hit the biggest party of the year, where a mysterious phenomenon disrupts the night, quickly descending into a chaos that challenges their friendships - and whether they can stay alive. A wild and hyperactive sci-fi thriller starring Logan Miller (Love Simon) and Rhys Wakefield (The Purge).

programme.title: Eternal Love
programme.desc: A heart-wrenching tale of young love, starring Jeremy Allen White (Shameless) and Maika Monroe (It Follows). When brash 23 year-old Elliot, meets the sensible Mia, and receives a damning diagnosis all in the same week, his world turns upside down. The pair discover the true test of their relationship. Featuring a stellar cast including Sasha Lane (American Honey) and Joe Keery (Stranger Things).

programme.title: Synchronic
programme.desc: From breakout genre filmmakers Justin Benson and Aaron Moorhead this mind-bending, haunting sci-fi stars Jamie Dornan (The Fall) and Anthony Mackie (Detroit). When New Orleans paramedics Steve and Dennis are called to a series of gruesome accidents, they chalk it up to a mysterious drug found at the scene. But when Dennis' daughter disappears, Steve stumbles upon a terrifying truth.

programme.title: A Great Divide
programme.desc: The Lee family leave the Bay Area for a fresh start in the rural expanses of Wyoming, only to encounter hostility and xenophobia in their new community. How they confront these issues will break them - or make them stronger.

programme.title: Teen Spirit
programme.desc: From the producer and musical team that brought you award-winning sensation LA LA LAND, comes TEEN SPIRIT. Fuel-injected with chart-topping pop anthems, ELLE FANNING takes centre stage in this uplifting Cinderella story about growing up, dreaming big, and finding your voice.

programme.title: Five Nights in Maine
programme.desc: A man, reeling from the tragic loss of his wife, travels to rural Maine to seek answers from his estranged mother-in-law, who is herself confronting grief. With David Oyelowo and Dianne Wiest.

programme.title: Jazzy
programme.desc: Jazzy is a portrait of Jasmine Bearkiller Shangreaux alongside her best friend Syriah and their peer group as relationships shift, change, and leave the dreamlike world of childhood behind.

programme.title: Filth
programme.desc: Bruce Robertson, a bigoted and corrupt policeman, is in line for a promotion and will stop at nothing to get what he wants. Enlisted to solve a brutal murder and threatened by the aspirations of his colleagues, Bruce sets about ensuring their ruin.

programme.title: Christmas Getaway
programme.desc: (2017) Holiday romance with Bridget Regan. A jet-setting travel writer decides to take some time off for Christmas, only to discover her cabin was double-booked by a single father and his daughter.

programme.title: Christmas on 5th Avenue
programme.desc: (2021) Christmas romance with Kathryn Davis. Christmas concierge Eva Jordan loves bringing festive joy to her clients. However, reclusive crime writer Lucas Blade might be her biggest challenge yet...

programme.title: Holiday Hotline
programme.desc: (2023) Phone-omenal romance with Emily Tennant. There's love on the line when a woman working at a switchboard connects with a charming anonymous caller - but she doesn't realise they've already met.

programme.title: Christmas in the Air
programme.desc: Robert, a widower and father of two children, enlists Lydia to help him juggle his chaotic work-life balance at Christmastime. Will their close relationship lead to love? Stars Catherine Bell. (2017)

programme.title: Christmas by The Book
programme.desc: A bestselling writer is dispatched by a TV talk show to a rural town where she is given two weeks to re-create the magical childhood Christmas described in her book. Starring Lindy Booth (2022)

programme.title: A Rainy Day in New York
programme.desc: Woody Allen's romantic comedy A RAINY DAY IN NEW YORK tells the story of college sweethearts, Gatsby (Timothée Chalamet) and Ashleigh (Elle Fanning), whose plans for a romantic weekend together in New York City are dashed as quickly as the sunlight turns into showers.

programme.title: Love In Wolf Creek
programme.desc: On the verge of losing her wildlife refuge, Sam, along with the town's handsome newcomer, Austin, risk it all to save an injured white wolf.

programme.title: The World We Make
programme.desc: 18 year old Lee (a spirited equestrian) and Jordan (an academic and football standout) are at the threshold of building a life together. But their character is tested when racial bias surfaces in their otherwise progressive small town.

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: Jenny Farrell has led an openly gay life - except with her conventional family. When she finally decides to start a family and marry the woman they thought was just her roommate, the small, safe world the Farrells inhabited changes forever.

programme.title: Hannah Takes the Stairs
programme.desc: Over the course of one hot post-graduate summer in Chicago, Hannah (Greta Gerwig), now a production office intern, falls precariously in and out of love.

programme.title: Back To Love
programme.desc: A young widow returns home for the first time in three years to help prepare her sister's wedding. She is forced to confront her past, including the man she never expected to fall for.

programme.title: Falling in Love at Christmas
programme.desc: Miranda and Paul, two rivals, meet on a costumed Santa crawl and spend a romantic evening together without learning each other's identities. As their anonymous romance continues online, their businesses merge, forcing them into an unwanted partnership.

programme.title: Christmas on Mistletoe Lake
programme.desc: Reilly finds herself in the magical town of Mistletoe Lake. She accepts the offer of Ray to stay in his boat, helping him renovate for the town's Christmas Harbor Festival. Reilly embarks on a journey to save the towns she fell in love with.

programme.title: Dancing Through Christmas
programme.desc: OLIVIA is picked to run the Christmas recital of The Nutcracker. When a video of Michael practising ballet with Lily goes viral, Olivia sees how much dance really means to the community. Will Olivia be able to save her dance studio with Michael's help?

programme.title: Lars and the Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars Lindstrom is an akwardly shy young man in a small town who finally brings home the girl of his dreams to his brother and sister-in-law's home. The only problem is that she's not real - she's a sex doll.

programme.title: Romance In The Air
programme.desc: After learning her marketing job is on the line, Eden returns to Lake Tahoe where she used to spend her summers growing up. Intending to relax and recharge so she can tackle her job again, she is surprised to find her childhood friend and sweetheart Riley is still living next door. She finds purpose in helping Riley propel his struggling hot air balloon tour company, and also finds herself drawn to him and their dear past. However, Eden sees Riley and Tahoe as temporary, while her life—and boyfriend—back home await her. She can't admit that she and Riley could have a future, even if that's exactly what she wants. When she's willing to take a risk for what her heart wants, her life will take off with her true love.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: A young finance executive inherits her uncle's mountain cabin only to discover that he also left half of it to the ruggedly handsome handyman that had been caring for it.

programme.title: Love In Aruba
programme.desc: A lonely teacher (Amber) is hired by Connor, the single father of a struggling student. She is to tutor his daughter Macey (age 10) over a summer while they travel for his work. As Amber helps Macey, she sees glimpses of what's missing in the family's life. Their grand destinations are filled with rich items and potential rewarding business deals, but it's missing heart. Amber's influence fills the void and brings Macey and Connor together. With it, Amber starts to fall in love with Connor, but can he see her as anything beyond the hired help?

programme.title: The Baby Proposal
programme.desc: Layla Bennett and Derek Dray are the hosts of Wake Up, Chicago and for the folks at home, their chemistry is undeniable. Derek is incredibly protective about the format of Wakeup, Chicago while Layla is always looking to shake things up. One morning they discover an adorable baby named Poppy left in a basket in Laylas dressing room. The mother passed away and the caretaker is unable to care for Poppy and is convinced that Layla and Derek will make perfect parents.

programme.title: Betrayed at 17
programme.desc: Widowed mom's joy as shy daughter dates football star, unaware of cruel bet.

programme.title: Fighting for the Kids
programme.desc: Chilling accounts of children in danger and the people who fought to protect them.

programme.title: Accused at 17
programme.desc: Bianca's prank on Dory, her boyfriend's fling, leads to a murder accusation.

programme.title: Dead at 17
programme.desc: Jason and friends hide a girl's body after a party accident, leading to guilt.

programme.title: Betrayed at 17
programme.desc: Widowed mom's joy as shy daughter dates football star, unaware of cruel bet.

programme.title: Bad Date Chronicles
programme.desc: Jeri Jones runs the popular website ‘Bad Date Chronicles' where daters can go to anonymously post horrible date experiences. Realizing he's the subject of one of the posts, rival blogger Jack Collins dares Jeri to three dates in an attempt to prove he's not such a bad guy after all.

programme.title: Wish You Were Dead
programme.desc: Hayley Udall tries to make ends meet for herself and her 14 year-old daughter while providing alimony for a horrible ex-husband. She wishes her problems with her ex could go away, and upon venting her frustrations one night, finds herself tangled up in a pact with two people (Melanie and Kevin) to “eliminate” each other's problems.

programme.title: Deadly Vows
programme.desc: Pastry chef Helena poisons men who don't meet her standards, but Helena's fiancé's sister smells danger.

programme.title: The Missing Sister
programme.desc: When Sharon tracks down her estranged sister she's elated to reunite—until she suspects that it's an impostor.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: An unlikely group of former '80s video game champions step up to save the world from an alien invasion in this visually spectacular action-adventure.

programme.title: Year One
programme.desc: After eating from the Tree of Knowledge, a primitive villager/slacker flees his people and encounters murderous Cain, slave traders, charismatic nutcase Abraham, and finally the city of Sodom. There the man falls for a princess, is hailed as "the chosen" by the oppressed people and ultimately leads a revolt that topples the government and frees the slaves. He heads off with the princess to visit Egypt....

programme.title: Man Of The House (2005)
programme.desc: A hard-edged Texas Ranger is forced to go undercover as an assistant cheerleading coach to protect a group of college cheerleaders after they witness a murder.

programme.title: Anger Management (2003)
programme.desc: A timid businessman is wrongly sentenced to an anger management program, where he has his life turned upside-down by an ultra-agressive instructor who hardly practices what he preaches.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: There are only a few days left before the Mother's Day, as several families have to come to terms with how they'll be spending the big day.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: FBI agent Malcolm Turner is known best for being a brilliant, master of disguise. Malcolm's latest assignment sends him to small-town Georgia, where he's assigned to trap a brutal bank robber who the FBI suspects will be coming down to visit his ex-girlfriend Sherry and her son.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: Big Momma is back — and this time he has big backup: his teenage stepson Trent (Brendan T. Jackson). Martin Lawrence returns as FBI agent Malcolm Turner and as Turner's deep-cover alter-ego Big Momma.

programme.title: Class Rank
programme.desc: CLASS RANK is a funny and touching coming-of-age drama in the vein of Election, Easy A or Legally Blonde, from the director of Glee...

programme.title: The Covered Wagon
programme.desc: Two wagon caravans converge at what is now Kansas City, and combine for the westward push to Oregon. On their quest the pilgrims will experience desert heat, mountain snow, hunger, and indian attack.

programme.title: More Dead Than Alive
programme.desc: Released from prison after 18 years, notorious gunslinger 'Killer' Cain is a peaceful reformed man but the Old West has died and he cannot adapt to the modern West where some unpaid moral debts and old troubles resurface.

programme.title: The Black Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Two black bounty hunters arrive in a small western town on the trail of an outlaw. Finding the town without a sheriff, they take charge, much to the displeasure of the mostly white townsfolk. As they chase women, demand money, and stir up trouble, they wait for the right moment to capture their prey, raising tensions along the way.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Colorized American Western Movie from 1946 starring Randolph Scott: Abilene Town - A sheriff tries to stop homesteader conflicts in the West after the Civil War.

programme.title: Caesar and Cleopatra
programme.desc: Vivien Leigh stars as Cleopatra in this lavish historical drama.

programme.title: Heart of the Matter
programme.desc: Harry Scobie, Deputy Commissioner of Police, commits his first offence which leads to his ultimate downfall.

programme.title: That Hamilton Woman
programme.desc: Laurence Olivier and Vivien Leigh star as Lord Nelson and Lady Hamilton.

programme.title: On the Night of the Fire
programme.desc: Kobling is a barber who steals £100 to pay off his wife's debt.

programme.title: Under the Ice
programme.desc: Despite terrible weather, Sidney drags Nigel along to an Arctic base where an ancient Indian mummy has been found, who turns out to be an Anasazi.

programme.title: Antianeirai
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel travel to Istanbul to investigate the death of one Sydney's friends, a professor who was trying to prove Hercules did exist by finding the Belt of Hippolyte.

programme.title: Faux Fox
programme.desc: When Nigel is charmed by brilliant student Lorraine to show her their offices (and kiss), a burglar knocks out Sidney, but what was robbed?

programme.title: Pandoras Box
programme.desc: Sidney inherits from the best relic hunter of the previous generation a key and rushes with Nigel on the hunt for the one treasure he never found: Pandora's box.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: Bekkastan, 1401 AD: warrior princess Kahina proves her right to rule. 2002: Sydney and Nigel unearth a cave painting that might lead them to Kahina's Saddle. But her descendants cause complications.

programme.title: Fountain of Youth
programme.desc: While Nigel rehearses his keynote speech in a Seville hotel room, a girl nearly breaks his nose demanding something - it turns out she was after the water from the Fountain of Youth.

programme.title: Arthurs Cross
programme.desc: Scotland Yard calls Sidney and Nigel to identify a 5th century murder weapon. It turns out to be the burial cross of King Arthur, but besides the victim several others are looking for it.

programme.title: So Shall It Be
programme.desc: When Sidney and Nigel are about to enter the site of a Bristol lecture, a young author approaches them to follow up immediately on a tip about a map to the lost keys to the druid cult in Stonehenge.

programme.title: Saints and Soldiers
programme.desc: Germany, May 1945, deep in the Harz Mountains a U.S. tank crew discovers a platoon of Germans preparing to ambush U.S. supply trucks. A deadly game of cat and mouse quickly unfolds as the Americans find themselves out-gunned and out-manned by three German tanks.

programme.title: Crimebusters
programme.desc: Two penniless friends decide to rob a store--but end up instead in a police office where they are drafted as new recruits. Starring Terence Hill and Bud Spencer.

programme.title: The Last Legion
programme.desc: As the Roman empire collapses, young Romulus Augustus must leave the city and set out for a dangerous journey to Britain to locate his last legion of supporters.

programme.title: A Perfect Plan
programme.desc: Four notorious thieves wake up in a fortified warehouse and are forced to commit an audacious diamond heist to win their freedom.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: On Sunday November 14, 1965 Lt. Col. Hal Moore and his regiment of 400 men touched down in a place in Vietnam known as "The Valley of Death". They found themselves surrounded by roughly 2,000 North Vietnamese soldiers and the ensuing battle became one of the most savage in US history.

programme.title: Faster
programme.desc: An ex-con sets out to avenge his brother's death after they were double-crossed during a heist years ago. During his campaign, however, he's tracked by a veteran cop and an egocentric hit man.

programme.title: Miss Bala (2019)
programme.desc: A beauty contest winner is forced to work for a crime boss after she witnesses a murder. Remake of the 2011 film.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Afterlife
programme.desc: In a world ravaged by a virus infection, turning its victims into the Undead, Alice (Jovovich), continues on her journey to find survivors and lead them to safety. Her deadly battle with the Umbrella Corporation reaches new heights, but Alice gets some unexpected help from an old friend. A new lead that promises a safe haven from the Undead takes them to Los Angeles, but when they arrive the city is overrun by thousands of Undead - and Alice and her comrades are about to step into a deadly trap.

programme.title: The Forgotten (2004)
programme.desc: Haunted by the memories of a son her husband swears she never had, a distraught mother's search for the truth leads to a mind-shattering conspiracy of unearthly terror.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: The Return
programme.desc: When the Universal Soldiers supercomputer goes haywire, Luc Deveraux is the only one who can battlethe elite team of deadly, near-perfect warriors.
